records.jp: これは、なんだろう……？
records.en_original: What could this be...?
records.en_auxiliary: What could this be...?
records.en: What could this be...?

records.jp: 台座……？　何かはまってますが……
records.en_original: A pedestal...? Something seems to be stuck...
records.en_auxiliary: A pedestal...? Something seems to be stuck...
records.en: A pedestal...? Something seems to be stuck...

records.jp: 感じる……
records.en_original: I feel something...
records.en_auxiliary: I feel something...
records.en: I feel something...

records.jp: これは、わたしが送り出したフラグメントなのです
records.en_original: This is the Fragment I sent out.
records.en_auxiliary: This is the Fragment I sent out.
records.en: This is the Fragment I sent out.

records.jp: えっ、それって――
records.en_original: You mean...
records.en_auxiliary: You mean...
records.en: You mean...

records.jp: ……こころん。台座に触れてみて。<CR>そうすればきっと、自分の想いと向き合えるから
records.en_original: Kokoro, touch the pedestal. If you do that, you'll be able to face your own emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro, touch the pedestal. If you do that, you'll be able to face your own emotions.
records.en: Kokoro, touch the pedestal. If you do that, you'll be able to face your own emotions.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Okay
records.en_auxiliary: ...Okay
records.en: ...Okay

records.jp: あなたは……わたし？
records.en_original: Are you...me?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you...me?
records.en: Are you...me?

records.jp: 教えて。わたしは……何を不安に思ってるの？
records.en_original: Tell me. What am I worried about?
records.en_auxiliary: Tell me. What am I worried about?
records.en: Tell me. What am I worried about?

records.jp: 本当に、成功するの？
records.en_original: Will this really work?
records.en_auxiliary: Will this really work?
records.en: Will this really work?

records.jp: それに、この世界での記憶がなくなったら……<CR>もう、みんなとは会えなくなっちゃうんじゃないの？
records.en_original: If I lose all my memories of this world, will I ever see the others again?
records.en_auxiliary: If I lose all my memories of this world, will I ever see the others again?
records.en: If I lose all my memories of this world, will I ever see the others again?

records.jp: それが、不安なんだね
records.en_original: That is my worry.
records.en_auxiliary: That is my worry.
records.en: That is my worry.

records.jp: ……思い出して、これまでのことを
records.en_original: I must remember...everything that happened here.
records.en_auxiliary: I must remember...everything that happened here.
records.en: I must remember...everything that happened here.

records.jp: この世界でたくさんの時間を過ごして……<CR>わたしたちは強くなった
records.en_original: We spent a lot of time in this world together. We became strong together.
records.en_auxiliary: We spent a lot of time in this world together. We became strong together.
records.en: We spent a lot of time in this world together. We became strong together.

records.jp: わたしと、みんなのつながりは<CR>そう簡単に切れたりしない
records.en_original: The connection that I have with everyone won't be broken so easily.
records.en_auxiliary: The connection that I have with everyone won't be broken so easily.
records.en: The connection that I have with everyone won't be broken so easily.

records.jp: だから、大丈夫
records.en_original: I'm not worried.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not worried.
records.en: I'm not worried.

records.jp: 本当に……？
records.en_original: Really...?
records.en_auxiliary: Really...?
records.en: Really...?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes.
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: こころ？　どうだった……？
records.en_original: Kokoro? What happened...?
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro? What happened...?
records.en: Kokoro? What happened...?

records.jp: ……最後の一押し、してきたのです
records.en_original: I gave myself one last push.
records.en_auxiliary: I gave myself one last push.
records.en: I gave myself one last push.

records.jp: これが、こころの想い……<CR>なんだか、温かい光だね
records.en_original: So these are your emotions... It's a warm glow, isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: So these are your emotions... It's a warm glow, isn't it?
records.en: So these are your emotions... It's a warm glow, isn't it?

records.jp: ……えへへ
records.en_original: Hehehe.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe.
records.en: Hehehe.

records.jp: 靭こころさんがグループから退出しました
records.en_original: Kokoro Utsubo has left the group.
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro Utsubo has left the group.
records.en: Utsubo Kokoro-san has left the group.

records.jp: こころがグループを抜けた？<CR>なんで突然……？
records.en_original: Kokoro left the group? What happened...?
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro left the group? What happened...?
records.en: Kokoro left the group? What happened...?

records.jp: この雫世界から抜け出して、<CR>想いをオリジンに届ける準備ができた……
records.en_original: It must be a sign that she's ready to leave Oasis...
records.en_auxiliary: It must be a sign that she's ready to leave Oasis...
records.en: It must be a sign that she's ready to leave Oasis...

records.jp: その合図なのかもしれないね
records.en_original: And deliver her emotions to Origin.
records.en_auxiliary: And deliver her emotions to Origin.
records.en: And deliver her emotions to Origin.

records.jp: そう、なんだね……。<CR>なんだかちょっと、寂しい気もするな
records.en_original: I see... That's actually a little sad.
records.en_auxiliary: I see... That's actually a little sad.
records.en: I see... That's actually a little sad.

records.jp: じゃあ、こうしてみんなのフラグメントを探して、<CR>自分の想いと向き合うことができれば――
records.en_original: So now we just need to find everyone else's Fragments and get our emotions in line...
records.en_auxiliary: So now we just need to find everyone else's Fragments and get our emotions in line...
records.en: So now we just need to find everyone else's Fragments and get our emotions in line...

records.jp: ――うん。想いを届けられる！
records.en_original: Yeah, then Origin should be able to hear us!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, then Origin should be able to hear us!
records.en: Yeah, then Origin should be able to hear us!

records.jp: ……今度こそ、最後の正念場みたいだね
records.en_original: I know we can do this...!
records.en_auxiliary: I know we can do this...!
records.en: I know we can do this...!
